end_to_end.expected: Auto-open off: after a reviewable hand a badge whose text equals the stored grades (A-2), coloured by worst grade with white text, 44px min; no panel; next hand auto-deals ~1.5 s later and the badge is gone; click opens Hand #n review and holds until Deal next hand; lone preflop fold shows no badge. Default app: panel opens, never a badge.
end_to_end.actual: Records harness (autoOpen:false), 9 hands mixed fold/call/raise in both browsers: badges '1 Major', '2 Major', 'All correct', etc. equal the stored grades; lone preflop folds (hands 1,4,7) show no badge; each gap result->next header was in [1400,1600] ms; badge count 0 after every deal. Keyboard Enter on the 2nd badge opens that hand's panel with one entry per stored decision, holds through 8 s of fake time, Deal next hand deals, and the next reviewable hand shows a badge again. Real app with auto-open off (10 hands, both browsers): badge texts such as '2 Major, 3 Minor' matched the stored records, the background was rgb(163,21,28) for major with white text, height >= 44px, axe clean, no panel; still on hand n after 1.35 s, dealt by 1.75 s; a click at +1 s opened and held the review; lone folds showed no badge; all requests were same-origin. Unmodified app (default on), 10 hands in both browsers: the panel opened on every reviewable hand and held, and no badge ever showed. The TableScreen edit was reverted and the tree is clean.
